properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF-garages pass: real OSM building footprint for UCSF's 1670 Owens Garage (entrance on C St off Owens, opposite Kaiser Permanente Mission Bay). OSM tags 5 levels/16 m height.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. Same situation as this project's other UCSF Mission Bay campus buildings: UCSF is state land, not carried in DataSF's Assessor secured tax roll (no blklot to join), so the real building footprint is the correct non-fabricated geometry.
properties.notes: A capacity figure (~820 spaces) appears in one secondary aggregator (parkchirp.com) only and is not independently confirmed; left out of facts rather than stated as fact.
